note: The floors a routed eval run may not fall below. Derived from four post-fix routed runs, forty case-draws: severity 40/40, the other four axes 39/40 each (one miss, the same CASE-1046 POL-SCOPE-1 wording ambiguity). Floors are rates snapped up to whole cases at the size of the run, so one axis point of model noise does not fail a build. The cost ceiling is the recorded $0.289-$0.303 band plus headroom; it catches the router silently degrading to strong everywhere (forced strong measured $0.51 on the same ten cases).
